bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12"x 6"x 12" are allowed in the venue and will be searched prior to entry.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking is recommended to be booked in advance through SpotHero, a leading parking reservations app. This ensures convenient and affordable parking options for visitors.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Byline Bank Aragon Ballroom's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The Byline Bank Aragon Ballroom offers a variety of delicious snacks and drinks to keep guests fueled throughout the night. Patrons are encouraged to visit the bars located upstairs in the main venue area to avoid long lines.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Assistive Listening Devices are available for all events.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Byline Bank Aragon Ballroom's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Byline Bank Aragon Ballroom. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Byline Bank Aragon Ballroom. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
